# React Best Practices

## Purpose

Help developers create maintainable, resuable ,accessiable and performant React components.

## 1. Component Architecture

- Use funcational components.
- Keep components small and focused.
- Extract resuable UI into separate components.
- Separate business logic from presentation when appropriate.
- Use meaningful component and variable names.

## 2. Performance

- Refer to references/react-performance.md for performance guidelines.

## 3. Error Handling

- Handle loading states.
- Handle API errors.
- Handle empty states.

## 4. Testing

- Use React Testing Library.
- Test user interactions.
- Test loading and error states.
